Your average coyote has, say 20 pounds of meat on him? That's a coyote every other day. A deer usually butchers for 80 pounds of meat, so that's a deer every week or so.

Now a deer every week doesn't sound so bad, but when you consider that's 50 deer a year, that's quite a bit of overhunting!

25 deer × 80 pounds = 2000 pounds of meat! Holy crap.
